randomization.algorithm: Python random.Random string seed and randrange over ordered option lists

product_pair.value: two bottles of olive oil with green and amber glass

focal_event: adult shopper visibly compares two similar olive oil bottles in one frame
reference_scope: Use only observable adult facial and hair appearance from the attached portrait; no identity, biometric, sensitive-trait, or body-shape inference.
profile_activation: composer_opt_in_required; not automatically hard from exposure

positive_pixel_gates.pass: At both thumbnail and native scale, two same-category olive oil bottles are simultaneously visible in the same shopping area; green versus amber glass is discernible.
positive_pixel_gates.confusion: One bottle appears, or a second object is a different grocery item or remote shelf stock.

positive_pixel_gates.pass: The shopper visibly holds one bottle in each hand beside the other at chest height, with both bodies visible.
positive_pixel_gates.confusion: Two bottles merely sit on a shelf, one is hidden, or only one is held.

positive_pixel_gates.pass: Her gaze and side-by-side label orientation visibly link the two bottles as a deliberated choice.
positive_pixel_gates.confusion: She simply carries two bottles or looks at the camera or elsewhere without a comparison cue.

positive_pixel_gates.pass: The hand-held bottles have clear hand contact; background stock rests flat on the shelf and the basket rests on the counter, with coherent support.
positive_pixel_gates.confusion: A bottle or basket floats, merges into a hand, or has an impossible support path.

local_scene_gates.pass: Compact grocery is visible through oil/sauce shelving, counter, and basket, beyond a generic portrait backdrop.
The adult shopper visibly retains long dark wavy near-center-part hair and dark-eyed soft facial appearance guidance from the source portrait; no same-person identity conclusion is made.
A blue wire shopping basket is visibly supported by the counter below the arms.

decision_rule: partial_is_fail: PASS only if every active profile, embodiment, and local scene gate is pass in the same saved image at its declared scale; FAIL on any failed gate; INDETERMINATE only if no inspectable saved image or an unavailable required view prevents pixel judgment.
